Resolve integration branch (batch record, then declared, then HEAD)
Resolve review base per PD1 with five refusals
Resolve remote (--remote, branch config, only remote, refusal)
Detect platform from remote URL, PD9 refusals
Create test-review-stack-prepare.sh in deployed-shape sandbox convention
Suite cases: PD1/PD9 refusals, remote-resolution branches, two static assertions

approaches_tried.approach: capture refusal exit code via $(...) command substitution in resolver functions
approaches_tried.reason: exit inside a command-substitution subshell only terminates the subshell, not the script; refactored resolvers to set global variables and call exit directly as plain statements
